evals.name: retry-safe-post
evals.prompt: Design an idempotent POST /payments endpoint that safely handles client network retries.
evals.expected_output: Idempotency key handling with atomic acquisition, cached response replay, and conflict protection.
assertions: Extracts Idempotency-Key header from incoming request.
Atomically claims the key in Redis or SQL with in-progress status.
Stores final response body and headers for replay on duplicate calls.

evals.name: replay-cached-result
evals.prompt: A client resends a charge request with an existing idempotency key whose transaction already succeeded.
evals.expected_output: Returns the previously stored response with identical status code, headers, and body without re-executing charge.
assertions: Detects that key is in completed state.
Replays cached response directly without calling payment gateway.
Includes an Idempotent-Replayed: true header or equivalent indicator.

evals.name: concurrent-duplicate-conflict
evals.prompt: Two concurrent HTTP requests arrive simultaneously with the identical Idempotency-Key while processing is in progress.
evals.expected_output: Rejection of the second request with HTTP 409 Conflict or waiting on lock release.
assertions: Detects concurrent execution via atomic lock/status.
Returns HTTP 409 Conflict or 425 Too Early to prevent duplicate side effects.
Avoids duplicate debit or double execution against downstream APIs.
